# Ultrastable: one page (SAFE NOW)

**Coding agents write code. Ultrastable runs the system.**

**Problem.** An idea needs a product, a brand, IP protection, a business plan, a search presence and marketing. Each is a hire or an agency, and a person still has to choose every task, check every result and notice every drift. Ideas die in the overhead.

**Solution.** Ultrastable is an autonomous system that takes one idea and bootstraps all of it, then keeps improving itself. You steer when you want; it manages itself otherwise. No development team, patent lawyer or marketing firm needed to start.

**Why now.** AI agents are good enough to do the work. What is missing is the layer that decides what is missing, checks results and reports without burdening the founder. Point tools cover pieces (site builders, analytics connectors); none integrates them with self-direction.

**Traction (honest).** Runs a first test case in production (self-reported, one installation). Seeking three design partners for 30-day pilots.

**Out of scope for now.** Financial back-end. Legal and patent outputs are drafts for professional review.

**Business model.** Subscription per venture, with usage-based model costs passed through (planning assumption).

**Team.** Rowan, inventor and product direction; the system runs much of its own operation.

**Ask.** Design partners now; cloud credits; a conversation about a pre-seed round when ready.

**Contact.** pilot@ultrastable.io · ultrastable.io
